title: Sleep In
statement: Given booleans `weekday` and `vacation`, return True if we sleep in: we sleep in unless it is a weekday and not a vacation.

title: String Times

statement: Given a string `name`, return "Hello " followed by it and an exclamation mark.

title: Double Char
statement: Given a string `s`, return it with every character doubled.

title: Count Evens
statement: Given a list `nums`, return how many of its elements are even.

title: Word Count

statement: Given strings `a` and `b`, insert `b` into the middle of `a` when `a` has exactly four characters, otherwise return `a`.

title: Common End
